title: Windows release acceptance
goal: Verify the integrated release through actual Windows entry points, old and fresh data, and current documentation.
dependencies: Phase 5 has gate.status = passed and all required evidence recorded
preserve: Existing package names and colocated tray/dashboard binaries
Validated defaults, preferences and features from phases 1–5
implementation: Build locked workspace in release mode. Run the full required Windows tests serialized for native GUI.
Smoke run both binaries colocated in an isolated test location. Validate startup, restart, tray, desktop popup, WebView2 and settings persistence.
Exercise the complete journey with a real local AI vision model and isolated cleaner fixtures. Test fresh and pre-change configuration.
Verify keyboard, narrow width, reported DPI/geometry and typical Windows scaling. Run deterministic DPI tests where desktop scaling is fixed.
Update README with startup, default black–orange interface, color setting, hotkeys, Local AI requirements and cleaner behaviors.

Measure native Ctrl+Alt+O cold and warm separately with a healthy local model: hotkey to picker, mouse release to visible popup, and popup to recognized text. Keep release executable unmodified and cite observed Windows environment.

test_notes: Native tests must use isolated fixture state. Existing user tray/dashboard instances should not be stopped or modified by release verification without authorization. If their global window class blocks required tests, use a permitted isolated Windows session or record the blocker and hold the gate.

The release acceptance runtime uses colocated ordinary `--release` binaries without `e2e`. Physical input and external HWND/UI Automation do not rely on debug-only bridge hooks. Preserve fixture time zone for full core parity tests. Build and verify only; do not publish, tag, or change a user machine.

findings.title: Native widget mouse fixture was hardcoded off-screen
findings.resolution: Derive synthetic fixture centre from live primary screen dimensions; both native pointer targets checked in bounds and original hover/leave/tooltip assertions rerun. No runtime behavior changed.

required: all required acceptance cases passed with evidence
independent orchestrator verification and real UI evidence
affected tests re-passed after any fix
gate.rule: Only the orchestrator can mark passed. Start the next phase only after this gate passes. The fix/retest milestone is inapplicable only when no post-review fix was needed and this is recorded.

limitations: The hosted desktop was Windows Server 2025 at 96 DPI; mixed-scale and negative-origin behavior is covered by deterministic geometry tests, not by a real multi-monitor desk. Timing observations are for this test setup, not a guarantee on other machines. No release publication.
